pr_title: fix: text jumps when editing on Android Chrome
pr_body:
solves #6469

Seems for some reason Excalidraw registers an element drag - that is why the text jumps.  Debouncing the call to dragSelectedElement() when `this.state.editingElement` solves the problem.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14358394/233725169-02e069ae-5f3a-495a-a4da-d68218428465.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14358394/233725430-84504155-a219-4471-b664-88236bc2e370.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14358394/233646888-fdbb3c59-b9a3-482a-b8a4-a24dc8033858.png)
> Debouncing the call to dragSelectedElement() when this.state.editingElement solves the problem.

Where does debouncing take place?
>> Debouncing the call to dragSelectedElement() when this.state.editingElement solves the problem.
> Where does debouncing take place?

I assume you found it in the meantime... Based on my debugging the root cause is `dragSelectedElements()` being triggered in `onPointerMoveFromPointerDownHandler()` in App.tsx while `this.state.editingElement` is true.

I don't think drag should be allowed while editing an element.
